observations: Two gas cylinders are shown in the foreground.
The orange cylinder on the left has a brass valve and a protective mesh.
The white cylinder on the right has a silver-colored valve and a damaged handle.
The white cylinder appears to be a 12.5kg capacity cylinder.
The photo contains a watermark for 'HITHE TECHNOLOGIES' and a date stamp '06/03/2025'.
The seller's text mentions 'Neatly used' but the white cylinder shows significant wear.

claims.evidence: The white cylinder in photo 0 and 1 shows a damaged handle and significant surface wear.
The capacity is not explicitly stated on the visible part of the cylinder.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired or past its re-test date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamped on the handle or shroud.

risks.risk: The valve may be leaking or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing a soap bubble test on the valve while under pressure.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or contain a different gas than LPG.
risks.proof: A photo of the cylinder's technical plate showing the gas type and weight.

proof_requests: Photo of the stamped markings on the handle or shroud showing the weight and expiry date.
Photo of the technical plate on the cylinder showing the gas type and capacity.
Video of the valve being tested for leaks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
